lines.text: The notice board has been updated. A new printed sheet — the official candidate list — has been laminated and added.

card.title: OFFICIAL CANDIDATE LIST — Alupotha Electoral Division
card.body:
1. Mahinda Bandara
2. R.M. Sumedha Kumari
3. T. Velupillai
4. W.A. Chandrasiri
card.footer: Elections Commission of Sri Lanka — Reference No. EC/2025/CL/12

lines.text: The list Uncle Sirisena shared had 'Pradeep Fernando' and 'Lalith Herath' on it. Neither name is here. And there is a W.A. Chandrasiri on the official list who was not in Uncle Sirisena's version at all.
You notice something in the bottom corner of the board — small, easy to miss. Not from the Elections Commission.

lines.prompt: There is a small handwritten note pinned to the corner of the board.

choices.label: Leave it. It is not an official notice.
